square[x_] := x^2
greet[name_String, times_Integer : 1] := StringRepeat["Hello, " <> name <> "!\n", times]
data = Table[square[i], {i, 1, 10}];
Plot[Sin[x] + Cos[2 x], {x, 0, 2 Pi}, PlotStyle -> Red]
If[Length[data] > 0 && True, Print[greet["Wolfram", 2]], Null]
